mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_api_calls ( id, user_id, feature, operation, correlation_id, provider, model, status, request_payload, response_payload, error_payload, candidate_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, started_at, completed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{feature}, #{operation}, #{correlationId}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{status}, CAST(#{requestPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{responsePayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{errorPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{candidateCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (feature, operation, correlation_id) WHERE correlation_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, model = EXCLUDED.model, status = EXCLUDED.status, request_payload = EXCLUDED.request_payload, response_payload = EXCLUDED.response_payload, error_payload = EXCLUDED.error_payload, candidate_count = EXCLUDED.candidate_count, input_tokens = EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = EXCLUDED.output_tokens, total_tokens = EXCLUDED.total_tokens, latency_ms = EXCLUDED.latency_ms, started_at = EXCLUDED.started_at, completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at
